candidates.name: Survey Data Catalogue projection information
verified_facts: All EA survey data is supplied in OSGB36 British National Grid.
Elevations are recorded above Ordnance Datum Newlyn.
LiDAR Composite uses OSTN15; time-stamped data requires survey-specific geoid metadata.
semantic_limits: Projection metadata does not replace exact raster-sampling evidence for a parcel.

candidates.name: Survey Data Catalogue vertical accuracy
verified_facts: EA specification requires absolute height error below +/-15 cm RMSE.
Expected relative random height error is no more than +/-5 cm.
Absolute error is defined against Ground Truth Survey results.
semantic_limits: These are source/specification accuracy statements, not parcel-specific 95% confidence guarantees.

candidates.name: LiDAR data metadata FAQ
verified_facts: Index catalogues are available for LiDAR products.
The catalogue includes information on time of year the data was collected.
semantic_limits: Metadata availability is lineage evidence; the exact survey used for a parcel must still be resolved.

candidates.name: LiDAR data coverage FAQ
verified_facts: The index catalogue shows product coverage by grid square.
semantic_limits: Missing catalogue coverage must fail closed and must not be interpreted as zero elevation or zero height difference.

candidates.name: Downloading large areas of LiDAR data
verified_facts: Open portal downloads use 5 km by 5 km LiDAR tiles.
Multiple tiles can be downloaded for relatively small areas.
semantic_limits: Tile packaging is a delivery convention and does not increase spatial or vertical accuracy.

candidates.name: GeoPackage spatial metadata index migration
verified_facts: LiDAR Composite downloads now include a spatial metadata index in GeoPackage format.
The GeoPackage describes spatial location and temporal extent of raster elevation data.
semantic_limits: Index metadata supports lineage/coverage QA but is not itself the elevation measurement.

candidates.name: ASCII to GeoTIFF LiDAR transition
verified_facts: 1 m and 2 m DTM Composite products are delivered as GeoTIFF.
GeoTIFF files are supplied in 5 km tiles with elevations in metres.
GeoTIFF enables web services such as WCS.
semantic_limits: Format efficiency and web-service availability do not imply better measurement accuracy.

candidates.name: National Grid Transformation OSTN15
verified_facts: OSTN15 is the definitive OSGB36/ETRS89 transformation.
It uses 1 km transformation grids with bilinear interpolation.
A simple Helmert transformation is limited to roughly metre-level applications.
semantic_limits: OSTN15 is a horizontal datum transformation and must not be conflated with vertical LiDAR error.

candidates.name: Transverse Mercator map projections
verified_facts: Transverse Mercator projection introduces distance scale distortion away from specific lines.
A scale reduction factor is used to reduce worst distortion across the mapping area.
semantic_limits: Projection scale effects are horizontal geometry QA, not terrain-height uncertainty.

candidates.name: OSGB36 British National Grid + ODN height EPSG:7405
verified_facts: EPSG:7405 is a valid compound CRS combining British National Grid and ODN height.
Its scope includes engineering survey and topographic mapping.
semantic_limits: EPSG:7405 is a reference contract; actual source raster metadata remains authoritative for sampling.
